name: ZeroBounce
tagline: Email validation and deliverability API for cleaning lists and verifying addresses
description: ZeroBounce provides REST APIs for real-time and bulk email validation, email scoring, activity data, and related deliverability tools. Developers authenticate with an API key and call endpoints to check whether addresses are valid, catch-all, disposable, or toxic before sending.

auth.details: API key as query parameter api_key (and often in POST body for bulk); self-serve signup in dashboard.

use_cases: validate a single email address before signup
bulk-clean a CSV of marketing list emails
score email quality risk for a lead
detect disposable or toxic email addresses
check domain age and MX for deliverability
